message: View "ActiveUsers" is not supported; Prisma 8 has no views. Remove the view or replace it with a model over the underlying table.

Field "User.search" has type "Unsupported(...)", which has no Prisma 8 codec, so a model with this field cannot use this contract source yet. Prisma 7 rejects @ignore on an Unsupported field, and removing the field drops its column on Prisma 7's next migration.
